title: npm Package Intelligence
description: Looks up npm package metadata, compares package versions, finds alternatives, and discovers packages for a described use case.
embeddingExamples: best npm package for date formatting

supportedIntents.description: Latest release, description, downloads, compatibility and deprecation details for a named npm package.
Compare two or three named npm packages or explicit versions.
Find related packages and their shared keywords and weekly downloads.
Search npm for packages matching a described development use case.
example: best npm package for date formatting

packageName.description: An npm package name, optionally followed by an explicit version such as express@4.

feature.description: Package information requested by the user.

schema.description: Structured query for npm package details, comparisons, alternatives, or use-case discovery.

type.description: Use query for named packages and list for package discovery.

filters.description: The requested action and package or development-use-case terms.

packages.description: One to three npm package names or version-qualified package references.

useCase.description: A developer need to search for when no exact package is named.

features.description: Package data the user wants to inspect.
